tasks.commitBody:
Calendar conventions retrofit, part 1 of 2 (PO standing rules 5 and 6).

Rule 5: time entry is 24h by default regardless of browser locale. The
three time inputs (series-create start time, event-create datetime,
event-detail start_datetime) now use TimeSelect — native hour and
minute selects, minutes in 5-minute steps by construction (the
step=300 addendum), with a legacy off-grid minute preserved as an
extra option so no stored value is ever snapped. The two datetime
surfaces pair TimeSelect with a native date input; the native date
picker is kept per PO ruling. A per-device time-format preference
(localStorage mvox.time_format, default 24h) on the profile page
switches TimeSelect to 12h with an AM/PM select; values are converted
back to 24h before writing. Stored and submitted values are unchanged.

Rule 6: the series-create day-of-week select lists Monday first
(display order 1..6,0); option values stay on the JS getDay()
convention so recurrence maths is untouched.

New Paraglide keys in en/et/lv/uk for the select labels and the
profile preference.

Part of #207 (rule 7 lands in the next commit).

tasks.commitBody:
Calendar conventions retrofit, part 2 of 2 (PO standing rule 7).

App-rendered numeric dates now use YYYY-MM-DD: season-management
start/end bounds, agenda recent-row dates, the event-create success
toast, library lending dates, and both invite-expiry displays (public
landing and admin surface). Formatting uses the ISO-producing Intl
pattern already in the codebase, keeping each site's Tallinn/UTC
handling so DST edges are unchanged.

Per PO ruling, narrative headers (agenda day groups, event detail)
keep weekday and month name, and native date pickers stay native —
forcing ISO rendering inside the browser's date widget is a separate
follow-up pending Mihkel's decision, not part of this slice.

Closes #207
